sentences.text: IA No. 274206/2025 - EXEMPTION FROM FILING O.T.)
This matter was called on for hearing today.

CORAM :
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANMOHAN HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE N.V. ANJARIA

For Petitioner(s) :
Mr. Sharath Chandran, Adv.
Mr. Shyam Gopal, AOR Ms. Shubhani. D.krishan, Adv. Mr. P . Krishnadevan, Adv.
UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following O R D E R Heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner.

Though respondent No.1 being the elder brother of the deceased was not a dependent as defined under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 19881, yet at the time of the accident, the mother of the deceased was alive and she admittedly was a dependent under Section 166 of the Act.

Consequently, the brother of the deceased as legal heir Royal Sundaram Alliance General ... vs Nagendiran on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2679467/
1 of the mother can certainly claim the compensation amount.
